question: A rectangular room measures 8 m long and 6 m wide. Its floor is to be covered with square tiles of side 40 cm. If 10% extra tiles are purchased for cutting and breakage, how many tiles are needed in total?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total exact tiles = (800 × 600) ÷ (40 × 40)

Total exact tiles = 480,000 ÷ 1,600 = 300

Total required with 10% extra = 300 × 1.1 = 330

**∴ The correct answer is 330 tiles.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of room (L) = 8 m = 800 cm

Width of room (W) = 6 m = 600 cm

Side of square tile = 40
